ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: capability between the two is effectively a tie here (their Creative Generation scores, 79.6 vs 82.7, and the relevant evals are close, and the documentation notes preferences don't affect output quality). So I used self-reported task preferences as a tiebreaker. The query is a warm, open-ended personal-statement drafting task — exactly the kind of work Lapwing reports disliking (it prefers well-specified extraction/reformatting with clear completion criteria) and the kind Whimbrel leans toward (positive warmth slope, friendly tone). Routing to the model that "prefers" the task costs nothing on quality and respects the stated preferences, so Whimbrel was the cleaner choice.
